detail: Northwestern Ohio won its third straight WHAC regular-season title at 25-3, and Madonna won the WHAC Tournament from the No. 3 seed. Lourdes and Siena Heights closed after the 2025-26 year, so the WHAC plays 2027 with 10 baseball programs. Every record here is as played: Rochester Christian's 31 forfeit listings are explained in the notes but not counted.

As played, from the box scores. The WHAC standings page lists the forfeits, so Rochester Christian shows 4-24 there and Madonna, Siena Heights, Lawrence Tech, Cornerstone, Lourdes and Michigan-Dearborn each show one or two more wins. WHAC RS-RA is runs scored and allowed in conference games and isn't available for Lourdes and Siena Heights, whose games with each other aren't in these box scores.

Conference regular-season games as played, row team's record against the column team. Lourdes and Siena Heights rows come from their opponents' box scores; their games with each other aren't included.

Season totals from NAIA stats for 11 teams and Rochester Christian's official totals, which NAIA stats doesn't carry and which include two fall games. The small number is the rank among the 12 2026 WHAC teams, 1 best. NAIA stats counts Lawrence Tech's two forfeit games as losses but its batting and pitching lines as played.

From the WHAC's Apr 28, 2026 release; awards are voted by the head coaches. 2027 status comes from each team's page: a posted 2027 roster where there is one, otherwise class. 16 of the 34 first- and second-team picks can return.

Back means on a posted 2027 roster, or a 2026 freshman, sophomore or junior where no roster is posted. Shares are of 2026 plate appearances and innings on player lines. Top returning bats need 100 at-bats and are ordered by OPS; arms by innings.

All 12 2026 WHAC teams. All games uses each team's season stats (NAIA stats for Siena Heights and Lourdes; Rochester Christian's official totals, which include two fall games). WHAC games uses the 28 conference regular-season games: box scores for the 10 2027 teams and NAIA conference splits for Siena Heights and Lourdes. Rate leaders need 2.5 plate appearances or 1 inning per team game. A red dot marks a player who can return in 2027. Click a name to open his player card.
Players who can return in 2027: hitters with 75 or more at-bats by OPS, pitchers with 20 or more innings by ERA. Status is from each team's page.

Conference series on 2027 schedules posted so far by Aquinas, Indiana Tech, Defiance, Rochester Christian, Madonna (partial) and Cleary (partial). Cornerstone, Lawrence Tech, Michigan-Dearborn and Northwestern Ohio haven't posted. When both teams list a series, the dates and game counts agree.

WHAC Tournament at Meijer Sports Complex in Rockford and Cornerstone University in Grand Rapids, Apr 30-May 3, from the WHAC's tournament page. Rochester Christian withdrew before it started. Madonna won the title; Northwestern Ohio (regular-season champion), Madonna and Indiana Tech played in the NAIA Opening Round.

label: Forfeits
detail: Rochester Christian self-reported an ineligible player in late April 2026, and its schedule now marks 31 games Forfeit. Twelve of them were Rochester Christian wins on the field and one more had its score changed. On this page and every team page those games count as played, which is why Rochester Christian is 13-15 here and 4-24 on the WHAC site.

label: Closures
detail: Siena Heights University closed at the end of the 2025-26 academic year (announced June 30, 2025) and Lourdes University at the end of spring 2026 (announced Feb 11, 2026). Both appear in the 2026 standings, stats and honors and are marked as closed.

label: 2027 tournament
detail: Defiance's 2027 schedule release lists the WHAC Tournament for May 5-9, 2027, for the top 8 teams. The WHAC hasn't posted a 2027 tournament page yet.

label: Checked
detail: Every game between two teams on this dashboard was matched from both sides by date and score. Each team's as-played record ties back to the WHAC standings page once Rochester Christian's forfeits are taken out, and the conference wins and losses balance at 168 each.

label: Not opinions
detail: This page lists results, numbers, honors and posted schedules. It does not predict a finish or rate any team.

label: 2026 regular-season champion
detail: Northwestern Ohio, 25-3

label: 2026 WHAC Tournament champion
detail: Madonna, 4-1 from the No. 3 seed

label: Player of the Year
detail: Aamir Mitchell, Madonna

label: Pitcher of the Year
detail: Daniel Healy, Northwestern Ohio

detail: 10, after Lourdes and Siena Heights closed

The 2026 All-WHAC first and second teams from the WHAC's Apr 28 release, placed at the positions the release lists. The release names four outfielders and two catchers on each team, and four starting pitchers. Hover or tap a name for his 2026 line and 2027 status.

Eight-team double elimination, Apr 30-May 3 at Meijer Sports Complex in Rockford and Cornerstone in Grand Rapids. A team was out after its second loss. Indiana Tech beat Madonna in game 14 to force a second final; Madonna won game 15 for the title.
Each WHAC team in the NAIA Opening Round played a four-team double-elimination bracket at a host site, May 11-13, 2026. None of the three advanced.
Wins and saves in WHAC games come from box-score decisions, which some teams' boxes leave blank, so those two lists are shown for all games only.
Pick two teams. Stats are all 2026 games with each team's rank among the 12 2026 WHAC teams (1 is best). The row in bold is the better rank.
Conference weekends from the 2027 schedules posted so far. A series shows for both teams even when only one has posted it. Blank cells mean nothing is posted yet for that team that week.
What each team has posted for 2027, from the checks on each team page. Hover a cell for the detail and the date it was checked.
All 2026 games as played. Expected wins use runs scored and allowed (exponent 1.83), the usual Pythagorean formula; the gap is actual wins minus expected wins. It describes 2026 only.
All 2026 games as played, from box scores and NAIA game logs. Comeback wins are wins after trailing at the end of an inning; Siena Heights and Lourdes inning lines aren't in this data.
Share of each 2027 team's 2026 plate appearances and innings that belong to players who can return: on a posted 2027 roster, or by class where no roster is posted.
